readmeMarkdown:
# Claude Studio **`agy-claude-studio`** — Native UI Aesthetics & Productivity Plugin for **Google Antigravity 2.33.1+ (v2.36.x Ready)** 5 Explicit Light & Dark Palettes · Persistent 3-Column Dock & Titlebar Plugin Pinning · 3-Tab Studio Sidecar (`Chat | Tools | Settings`) · `/btw` & `/compact` Workflows · Mobile Push Alerts · Gemini 4 Periodic Table · 4 Native Skills · Pixel Clawd Mascot

English · 简体中文

[Preview](#preview) · [Features](#features) · [Quick Install](#quick-install) · [Companion Plugin](#companion-plugin) · [Configuration](#configuration) · [FAQ](#faq) · [Credits](#credits--license)
--- > **About this project**: `Claude Studio` (`agy-claude-studio`) is a community-driven enhancement for Google Antigravity, evolved from [0DNANCY/agy-claude-style](https://github.com/0DNANCY/agy-claude-style). It connects seamlessly at runtime through Antigravity's built-in **Chrome DevTools Protocol (CDP)** — leaving host installation files completely untouched, adding no extra messages or prompt overhead to your conversations, and letting you return to the stock UI with a single click whenever you like. --- ## Preview
#### Full Workspace Overview (Claude Warm Light + Home Usage Heatmap + ASCII Ripple Sea + Persistent Studio v2.3.0 Sidecar + Clawd)
#### 5 Symmetric Explicit Light & Dark Palettes (Claude Light/Dark, Obsidian Light/Dark & Follow Host)
#### Persistent 3-Column Studio Dock (Far-Right Third Column Alongside Browser, Files & Terminals)
#### Context Control: Low-Context Red Alert, `/btw` Side-Questions & `/compact` Presets
#### Model Selector & Dual-Style Effort Sliders

Gemini 4 Periodic Table Model Selector: search, category filters, quota badges & direct AI Studio sync
Dual-Style 60fps Effort Sliders: ChatGPT Starry Nebula & Claude 5-Row Dot Matrix, plus off to keep native

#### Workflow Efficiency: On-Demand Skills & Marketplace Translate, Titlebar Plugin Pinning (`📌` + `✦`) & Workspace Quick Actions
#### Claude Studio Sidecar × Usage Monitor Companion

Claude Studio Sidecar: compact accordion Settings, on-demand locale packs, beta channel & 1-click header upgrade
Usage Monitor Companion: coexists cleanly alongside the independent 3-column dock and pins to the titlebar in one click
--- ## Features Here is a quick tour of what Claude Studio adds on top of Antigravity — everything runs in memory over CDP, so your installation files stay untouched and you can switch back to the stock UI anytime. ### Persistent 3-Column Studio Dock & 3-Tab Sidecar (`Chat | Tools | Settings`) Pin Claude Studio to the far right as an independent third column (`pinRightPane: 'studio' | 'off'`) so it stays visible alongside built-in browser previews, file viewers, terminals, or other Aux Pane tabs without competing for space. It also supports solo dock mode when no Aux Pane is open, yields with zero-frame delay whenever the Aux Pane is maximized (such as full-screen image viewing) and restores cleanly afterward, and collapses down to `0px` into a single terracotta `✦` button in the conversation titlebar when you want full width. - **Chat**: Features a Claude-style Environment & Git Worktree selector menu (with `.repo + worktree/` container repository detection and a dark branch hover tooltip), connected tools summary, and a billing-aligned context breakdown by category (system prompt, MCP tools, skills, rules, and conversation). At the bottom, live activity tracks active tasks with one-click pinning, streaming previews, subagents, and full `/btw` side-question threads marked with concise `Side` badges. - **Tools**: A local script runner for Node, Python, and Shell scripts, pre-seeded with an Antigravity official changelog fetcher (`scripts/fetch-agy-changelog.mjs`) with automatic Chinese translation, alongside a mobile push quick panel. Script output opens in a **wide Markdown card right above the chat box** — purely local, never triggering an AI turn — where you can copy, collapse/expand without losing logs, or re-open anytime via the `Wide` button. - **Settings**: Organized into a compact single-open accordion covering themes, layout, effort slider style, on-demand locale packs, an opt-in Beta update channel (`receivePrerelease`), and HUD options, all persisted automatically. The single-row header includes a 1-click **Upgrade** button that updates in place, automatically cleans up pre-v2.2.4 legacy root files against a SHA-256 allowlist (preserving any user edits and local data), and triggers a clean hot re-injection. ### Titlebar Pinning for Any UI Sidecar Plugin Keep your favorite sidecar plugins one click away in the conversation header: - Every row in the `⋮ → Plugins` submenu includes a `📌` pill to pin or unpin any UI sidecar plugin without opening it or closing the menu. - Pinned plugins appear with their original icons lined up to the left of `⋮` and support **3-state click toggling** (open / switch / close-collapse). - Automatically deduplicates against the collapsed Claude Studio `✦` button so the titlebar stays uncluttered. ### 5 Explicit Light & Dark Palettes Choose from five symmetric palettes — **`claude`** (Claude Light), **`claude-dark`** (Claude Dark), **`obsidian`** (Obsidian Light), **`obsidian-dark`** (Obsidian Dark), and **`host`** (Follow Host). Explicit light and dark palettes render consistently regardless of Antigravity's own light or dark theme, covering CSS tokens, code syntax highlighting, usage charts, effort sliders, glassmorphism overlays, and the Studio sidecar panel. ### Model Picker, Reasoning Effort, `/compact` & `/btw` - **Grouped Model Pill & Gemini 4 Periodic Table**: Combines `✦` and the model name into a unified hover/open pill (suppressing the overlapping native model menu), paired with a separate equal-height reasoning effort pill. The periodic-table grid organizes models by tier and capability with instant search, category filters, quota badges, and direct sync from Google AI Studio. - **Orchestrator Quick Switch**: Sits right next to the model picker to toggle multi-agent mode in one click, remembers your choice across restarts, and locks while a turn is running so you do not flip it mid-stream. - **Dual-Style 60fps Effort Slider & Composer Isolation**: Pick between ChatGPT Starry Nebula (`chatgpt`), Claude 5-Row Dot Matrix (`claude`), or `off` to keep Antigravity's native effort control (which narrows the Periodic Table entry to `✦` only). Disabling `composerRestyle` cleanly isolates native composer layout and glass styling. - **`/compact` Presets & Seamless `/btw` Token Swaps**: Five customizable `/compact` presets — **Empty** (`empty`), **Clean Focus** (`clean`, default), **Dev Handoff** (`dev`), **Continue** (`continue`), and **Custom** (`custom`). Switching between `/compact` and `/btw` replaces existing Lexical slash tokens cleanly in place while preserving normal drafts and active IME composition, without auto-sending. ### Antigravity v2.36.0 Localization & On-Demand Translation - **Full Antigravity v2.36.0 Coverage**: Covers Side Question, New Tab, Settings, dialogs, and the `/swarm` multi-agent sidecar with a fast DOM observer engine, plus stale cloud pack protection so older remote packs never overwrite newer built-in strings. - **On-Demand Language Packs**: English (`en`) and Simplified Chinese (`zh-CN`) ship bundled; Traditional Chinese (`zh-TW`), Cantonese (`yue`), and Japanese (`ja`) download on demand with SHA-256 verification, clearly showing `Cloud` vs. `Cloud Updated` status badges in Settings. - **Marketplace & Skills On-Demand Translate Pills**: Adds on-demand translate pills to both the Plugin Marketplace and `Settings → Skills` / `/customizations`. Zero background network requests are made until you click; translations preserve code identifiers, fall back automatically if a provider rate-limits, toggle cleanly back to the original text, and respect `translate="no"`, `.notranslate`, a cloud protection list, and your custom `i18nIgnoreSelectors`. ### Chat File Link Right-Click Menu When the assistant links a local file or drops an `@` mention pill in chat, right-click it to: - **Open File** with your OS default app (restricted to safe document, code, and media file types). - **Reveal in Folder** — uses `explorer.exe /select` directly on Windows for fast, flicker-free selection (falling back to the native helper only for edge cases like commas in paths) and highlights the file in Finder on macOS. - **Copy Full Path** straight to your clipboard. Toggleable anytime via `fileLinkContextMenu` in Settings. ### Mobile Push Notifications When you kick off a long refactor or batch run and step away from your desk, Claude Studio can notify your phone locally through Antigravity's Stop Hook as soon as the run finishes or encounters an error. - **8 supported channels**: ServerChan (supports full Markdown up to ~28KB), Bark (iOS), ntfy, Feishu, DingTalk, WeCom, Telegram Bot, and custom Webhooks. - **Sensible defaults**: Filters out quick turns (default threshold is 3 minutes), alerts immediately on errors, and stays quiet when you cancel a run manually. - Credentials and webhook URLs stay local in `PLUGIN_DATA/notify.json` — nothing is written to `config.json` or injected into web views. ### Visual Polish, Loading Animation & Clawd - **Craft & Home Dashboard**: Optional frosted glassmorphism borders, `logoInk` top-left icon tinting, a CJK-friendly smooth typing caret, and a Studio home dashboard featuring a usage heatmap and interactive ASCII wave ripple. - **Loading Animation (`geminiLoader`)**: Swaps out Antigravity's large stock loading spinners for animated Gemini-chan with a crisp 12-tick overhead ring. - **Pixel Companion Clawd**: A 19-state pixel crab perched on your composer that reacts to pokes, tickles, drags, and assistant activity (thinking, typing, error, done), and automatically dodges Q&A cards or queue bars. ### 4 Native Skills Built-in conversational workflows you can invoke right in chat: - **`studio-setup`**: 30-second guided initial configuration. - **`studio-doctor`**: Checks CDP connectivity, permissions, and running processes, and fixes common issues. - **`studio-notify`**: Step-by-step wizard to configure and test mobile push notifications. - **`studio-translation-protect`**: Helps you add custom CSS selectors to the translation exclusion list. --- ## Companion Plugin: `antigravity-usage-monitor` `Claude Studio` focuses on **visual aesthetics, interaction craft, live workspace inspection, and localization**. If you also want real-time generation speed (`tok/s`), time-to-first-token (TTFT) latency, cost estimates, and multi-model quota pools, pair it with the independent companion plugin **[yuhuan-dev/antigravity-usage-monitor](https://github.com/yuhuan-dev/antigravity-usage-monitor)**: - **Independent Side-by-Side Coexistence**: In `v2.3.0`, Claude Studio occupies its own far-right third column (`pinRightPane: 'studio' | 'off'`), so it coexists side-by-side with `Usage Monitor` inside the Aux Pane without competing for the same slot. - **One-Click Titlebar Pinning**: Open `⋮ → Plugins` in the conversation header and click the `📌` pill next to **Usage Monitor** to pin its original icon to the titlebar for instant 3-state toggling (open / switch / close-collapse) alongside Claude Studio. - **Zero-Conflict HUD & Localization**: Claude Studio's built-in lightweight HUD defaults to a clean top bar (`usageStatsEnabled: true`, `hudTopBar: true`, `hudBottomBar: false`, `hudRimProgress: false`) and can be toggled off anytime in Settings. The localization engine permanently skips `#ag-usage-monitor-*` elements via `i18n-compat.json`. - **Smart Footer Splitting**: When `usage-monitor` docks into the composer footer, Claude Studio mirrors its context progress ring cleanly to the far right, eliminating layout collisions or visual clutter. - **Clean License Boundary**: Claude Studio is licensed under **MIT**, while `antigravity-usage-monitor` is licensed under **GPLv3**. Both plugins are completely decoupled and install independently. --- ## Quick Install ### Requirements - **Google Antigravity Desktop `2.33.1+`** (tested through `2.36.x`; Windows / macOS / Linux) launched with `--remote-debugging-port=0`. - **Node.js `>= 22`** (zero third-party npm dependencies; uses built-in `fetch`, `WebSocket`, and `node:test`). ### Fastest Way: Ask Gemini in Antigravity (Recommended) No terminal commands needed. Simply paste this repository URL into any Antigravity conversation and ask: > **Help me install this Antigravity plugin: `https://github.com/eosglyph/agy-claude-studio`** Once installed, you can ask Gemini to run the built-in setup skills: - *"Walk me through 30s Claude Studio setup"* (`studio-setup`) - *"Help me set up mobile push alerts"* (`studio-notify`) - *"Diagnose Claude Studio"* (`studio-doctor`) #### Upgrading from an Older Version If you already have Claude Studio installed and want to upgrade to the latest release, click **Upgrade** in the Claude Studio sidecar header, or paste this prompt into Antigravity: > **Please follow the Upgrade & Legacy Migration Checklist in README.md and the latest Release Notes at `https://github.com/eosglyph/agy-claude-studio` to upgrade/migrate my local Claude Studio to the latest version.** *(Note: If you previously gave an upgrade instruction mentioning a specific older release like v2.2.1, this exact same checklist applies to upgrading to the latest version.)* #### Optional Dual-Pane Setup To install Claude Studio alongside the independent usage monitor companion in a single step, ask Gemini: > **Help me install `https://github.com/eosglyph/agy-claude-studio` along with the companion plugin `https://github.com/yuhuan-dev/antigravity-usage-monitor`** --- ### Upgrade & Legacy Migration Checklist Whether upgrading manually, running the installer, or delegating the upgrade to an AI coding assistant, follow this checklist: 1. **Preserve User Data**: All user preferences, webhook credentials, script definitions, and downloaded language packs reside in `~/.gemini/antigravity/plugin_data/agy-claude-studio/` (`config.json`, `notify.json`, `notify-state.json`, `scripts.json`, `i18n-packs/`) and custom operational scripts in `scripts/ops/`. These files must be preserved across updates. First-time launches automatically migrate legacy configurations from `plugin_data/agy-claude-style/config.json`, and in-place upgrades from pre-`v2.2.4` versions automatically clean up retired root-level files via a SHA-256 allowlist while leaving any user-modified files untouched. 2. **Legacy Windows Watcher Migration (`agy-claude-style-watcher.exe`)**: - Simply updating plugin files or extracting into a new `agy-claude-studio` directory does **not** stop or replace an older standalone `agy-claude-style-watcher.exe` running from a previous installation directory (such as `%LOCALAPPDATA%\agy-claude-style`). - If running the Windows 1-Click Installer (`Claude-Studio-v-Windows-x64.exe`), legacy cleanup and migration are handled completely automatically. - If upgrading manually or via an AI coding assistant from `v2.1` / `v2.2` / `agy-claude-style`: perform a read-only check first for any running `agy-claude-style-watcher.exe` process or legacy Startup / Add-or-Remove-Programs entries. Ask the user for confirmation before stopping or uninstalling the legacy watcher. Once the legacy watcher has exited, enable the new native plugin (which cleanly unloads and stops injecting whenever toggled off in Plugins). 3. **Hot-Refresh & Verify**: If Antigravity is already running with `--remote-debugging-port=0`, run `npm run inject` (or `node src/inject.js`) from the plugin directory to hot-refresh active windows without restarting. **Never force-kill a running Antigravity process without explicit user confirmation.** After enabling the plugin, run `studio-setup` or `studio-doctor` to confirm everything is operational. --- ### Installation Options #### Option 1: Windows 1-Click Native Plugin Installer (Recommended for Windows)
Download `Claude-Studio-v-Windows-x64.exe` from [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/eosglyph/agy-claude-studio/releases) and double-click to run: - Features a redesigned **Claude warm-ivory** native setup interface with zero external runtime requirements. - Automatically detects and cleans up legacy `v2.1.0 / v2.2.0 / v2.2.1` standalone watchers, older `agy-claude-style` plugins, and pre-`v2.2.4` legacy root files while preserving all personal configuration files and custom scripts. - Installs and enables the complete native plugin into `%USERPROFILE%\.gemini\config\plugins\agy-claude-studio`. - Creates persistent Desktop and Start Menu shortcuts featuring the custom **Gemini × Clawd** icon pointing directly to your local `Antigravity.exe --remote-debugging-port=0`. - Supports clean uninstallation via Windows Settings → Installed Apps. #### Option 2: Cross-Platform Universal Plugin ZIP & Manual Clone Download `Claude-Studio-v-plugin.zip` from [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/eosglyph/agy-claude-studio/releases): - Extract the archive into `~/.gemini/config/plugins/` (creating `~/.gemini/config/plugins/agy-claude-studio`). - Fully quit Antigravity (including the system tray icon) and relaunch with `--remote-debugging-port=0` (or run `npm run launch` / `node src/inject.js --launch`). - Confirm **`Claude Studio`** is enabled under **Customizations → Plugins**. > **Platform Note**: The maintainer does not currently have access to physical Mac hardware. macOS and Linux users are encouraged to install via the universal `plugin.zip` or by asking Gemini in Antigravity. Real-hardware feedback is warmly welcomed!
Manual Git Clone, Local Builds & Companion Scripts - **Manual Git Clone**: ```powershell # Windows (PowerShell) git clone https://github.com/eosglyph/agy-claude-studio.git "$env:USERPROFILE\.gemini\config\plugins\agy-claude-studio" ``` ```bash # macOS / Linux git clone https://github.com/eosglyph/agy-claude-studio.git "$HOME/.gemini/config/plugins/agy-claude-studio" ``` - **Build Windows Native Plugin Installer / Universal Plugin ZIP Locally**: ```bash npm run build:installer # Or build the universal plugin ZIP alongside node scripts/build-installer.mjs --plugin-zip dist/Claude-Studio-plugin.zip ``` - **Windows Companion Launcher Pack (with Gemini × Clawd Icon)**: ```powershell npm run build:release powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\companion\setup-companion.ps1 ``` When the native plugin is already installed, the companion launcher script automatically yields and simply launches Antigravity with `--remote-debugging-port=0` and the custom icon. - **Build macOS Universal `.app` / `.dmg` Locally**: ```bash npm run build:macos ``` Produces a universal (`arm64` + `x86_64`) `Claude Studio.app` and `Claude-Studio-v-macOS-universal.dmg`. If macOS Gatekeeper flags an ad-hoc signed binary on first launch, right-click → **Open** or run `xattr -cr "/Applications/Claude Studio.app"`.
Option 3: Node.js CLI & Local Development ```bash cp config.example.json config.json # Optional; default configuration works out of the box npm run inject # One-shot injection into active windows npm run watch # Live hot-reloading watcher for local development npm run remove # Disconnect and cleanly restore native UI ```
--- ## Meet Clawd
| Interaction | How to Trigger | What Happens | | --- | --- | --- | | Poke | Click on the left or right side of Clawd | Shy head-turn reaction (`poke-left` / `poke-right`) | | Tickle | 4 rapid clicks within `450ms` | Laughing leg-kick celebration (`tickle`) | | Pick up | Click & drag across the screen | Dangling wiggle, gently floats down on release (`drag`) | | Nap | Leave the app idle for 60s+ | Dozes off to sleep (`sleeping`), stretches awake on click or new message (`waking`) | | Live state | Thinking / typing / error / done | Mirrors your assistant's state in real time and automatically sidesteps Q&A cards and queue bars | --- ## Configuration Everyday preferences can be adjusted in real time from the right-side **Claude Studio → Settings** tab and persist automatically across restarts (see [config.example.json](config.example.json) for the full schema). Mobile push notification settings and webhook tokens are stored privately on your local machine in `PLUGIN_DATA/notify.json` and are never written to `config.json` or injected into browser pages.

--- ## FAQ
1. Not injecting automatically after updating to Antigravity 2.33.0+? Starting in `2.33.0`, Antigravity disables the CDP remote debugging port by default. Fully quit Antigravity (including the background system tray icon) and relaunch it with `--remote-debugging-port=0`, or use the one-click relaunch button in the Studio panel / `npm run launch` (`node src/inject.js --launch`). You can also ask Gemini *"Diagnose Claude Studio"* to trigger the `studio-doctor` skill for automated troubleshooting.
2. How do I use `Usage Monitor` alongside Claude Studio now? Starting in `v2.3.0`, Claude Studio runs in its own **independent far-right 3rd column** (`pinRightPane: 'studio' | 'off'`), so it no longer competes with `Usage Monitor` for the Aux Pane slot — both panels can stay open side-by-side cleanly. For quick one-click toggling, open `⋮ → Plugins` in the conversation titlebar and click the `📌` pill next to **Usage Monitor** to pin its icon directly left of `⋮` (supporting 3-state open / switch / close-collapse).
3. Why are sidebar right-click context menus still in English? Sidebar item context menus are rendered directly by Electron via operating system APIs (Win32 / NSMenu) outside the browser DOM. Non-destructive CDP injection operates purely within the web environment and cannot modify OS-level menus. All application DOM views, settings pages, dialogs, and the Swarm sidecar support full 5-language localization.
4. How do I completely restore the native Antigravity UI? Click **Restore Native** in the **Claude Studio** panel, toggle `Claude Studio` off in Antigravity Plugins, or run `npm run remove`. No host files are ever modified, and the stock UI is restored immediately.
5. Windows Non-TUN / Process-Level Proxy Setup Tips If you run Windows without TUN mode or a system-wide proxy and instead inject process-level proxy variables via a launcher script when starting Antigravity: 1. **Initial Launch Shortcut**: Point your `Antigravity (Claude Studio).lnk` shortcut to your process-level proxy launcher (make sure it forwards `%*` arguments) and include `--remote-debugging-port=0` in the shortcut arguments. 2. **Recommended Environment Variables** (using local proxy `127.0.0.1:7890` as an example): ```bat set HTTP_PROXY=http://127.0.0.1:7890 set HTTPS_PROXY=http://127.0.0.1:7890 set NODE_USE_ENV_PROXY=1 set NO_PROXY=localhost,127.0.0.1,::1 ``` - `NODE_USE_ENV_PROXY=1` enables Node.js 22+ built-in `fetch` to honor proxy variables, allowing sidecar **self-update checks**, **Gemini 4 Periodic Table sync**, and **on-demand language pack downloads** to route through your proxy; - `NO_PROXY=localhost,127.0.0.1,::1` keeps local CDP debugging and `language_server` loopback traffic direct; - You can also set `ALL_PROXY` if your environment uses SOCKS5. 3. **Automatic Proxy Retention on Sidecar Relaunch**: When relaunching Antigravity from the right-side **Claude Studio** panel, the plugin automatically forwards `HTTP_PROXY`, `HTTPS_PROXY`, `ALL_PROXY`, `NO_PROXY`, and `NODE_USE_ENV_PROXY` into the relaunched `Antigravity.exe` process and cleans up the temporary relaunch script upon completion or failure. Users on TUN mode or direct connections experience zero behavior change.
--- ## Development & Testing ```bash npm test # Run automated test suite (Node.js >= 22, zero dependencies) npm run build:installer # Build Windows single-file x64 installer npm run build:release # Build Windows companion launcher release pack npm run build:macos # Build macOS Universal .app & .dmg (requires macOS environment) ```

# Claude Studio v2.3.0

> [中文](#更新亮点) · [English](#whats-new-in-v230)

## 更新亮点

`v2.3.0` 围绕多栏工作区协作与视觉一致性进行了大幅演进：推出**独立常驻三栏 Claude Studio 侧栏**与**对话顶栏任意插件快捷钉住**，升级 **5 套对称显式浅/深配色**，带来 Claude 风格环境分支菜单与完整 `/btw` 旁支提问工作流，同步完成 Antigravity `v2.36.0` 界面汉化、技能说明按需翻译胶囊、暖白 Windows 安装器改版，以及面向 CLI 隔离、旧文件自清理与 Windows 代理环境变量透传的多项可靠性加固。

### 1. 独立常驻三栏侧栏与对话顶栏插件钉住

- **独立常驻三栏 Dock**：支持将 Claude Studio 固定在窗口最右侧作为独立第三栏（`pinRightPane: 'studio' | 'off'`），打开浏览器、文件预览、终端或其他辅助面板标签页时互不遮挡，同时支持单栏独立常驻、SVG 侧栏徽标与辅助侧栏防抖动及宽度前置保护。
- **全屏看图零帧让位与顶栏 `✦` 折叠**：当辅助面板最大化（如全屏查看图片）时，常驻 Studio 侧栏与 iframe 零帧延迟自动隐藏让位，退出最大化后自动恢复；手动折叠常驻侧栏后会收成 `0px`，改为在对话顶栏 `⋮` 左侧展示单枚陶土红 `✦` 展开按钮。
- **对话顶栏任意插件快捷钉住**：在 `⋮ → 插件` 子菜单每行右侧新增 `📌` 钉住胶囊，点击即可一键钉住或取消钉住任意 UI 侧栏插件（不误触打开插件、不关闭菜单）；已钉住的插件会以原版图标排列在对话顶栏 `⋮` 左侧，支持三态点击（打开 / 切换 / 关闭收起），与常驻 Studio 折叠 `✦` 按钮自动去重，并可在「设置 → 进阶交互 → 顶栏插件钉选」随时开关，同时修复了多会话缓存下的跨会话桥接串扰与辅助栏关闭按钮误判。

### 2. 5 套对称显式浅色与深色配色

- **跨宿主明暗的 5 项显式选择**：配色方案升级为 `Claude 暖灰（浅色）`（`claude`）、`Claude 暖灰（深色）`（`claude-dark`）、`黑曜石（浅色）`（`obsidian`）、`黑曜石（深色）`（`obsidian-dark`）与 `跟随宿主`（`host`）五项对称选项，5 语种设置下拉清晰标明浅色、深色与跟随宿主。
- **端到端一致渲染**：显式浅色与显式深色不再受 Antigravity 宿主自身明暗模式制约，完整覆盖界面变量、代码块语法高亮、图表色板、思考强度滑块、毛玻璃浮层与 Claude Studio 控制室侧栏；同步将 Gemini 娘加载动效升级为 12 刻度光环。

### 3. Claude 风格环境菜单、/btw 旁支提问与输入区打磨

- **Claude 风格环境菜单**：新增环境分支与 Git Worktree 快速切换菜单，支持 `.repo + worktree/` 容器仓库识别与暗色分支悬浮提示。
- **完整 `/btw` 旁支提问工作流**：控制室「对话」页完整追踪 `/btw` 旁支提问，统一空态与有项时的平静卡片样式、隔离多会话串扰，并将实时运行状态中的旁支角色徽章精简标为 `旁`（英文 `Side` / 日文 `副`）。
- **`/compact` 继续压缩与无感斜杠令牌切换**：`/compact` 预设新增 `continue`（「继续压缩」）选项；在 Lexical 输入框中点击切换 `/compact` 与 `/btw` 时可原位无感替换已有斜杠令牌，同时完整保留普通草稿内容与输入法组合状态（IME）。
- **模型胶囊分组与原生控件隔离**：将 `✦` 图标与模型名称合并为统一的悬浮/展开胶囊（同时拦截原生模型菜单避免重叠），思考强度独立为等高胶囊；新增 `effortSliderStyle: 'off'` 以保留原生思考强度控件（此时元素周期表收敛为仅由 `✦` 进入）；关闭 `composerRestyle` 时彻底隔离原生输入框布局与毛玻璃影响。

### 4. Antigravity v2.36.0 本地化、技能翻译胶囊与按需语言包

- **Antigravity v2.36.0 全量词条补齐**：覆盖 `v2.36.0` 新增的旁支提问、新建标签页与设置页文案，同步更新 4 套语言包离线词库及动态规则；新增过期云端词库保护机制，避免旧版远端语言包覆盖新版内置词条。
- **技能页按需翻译胶囊**：在「设置 → 技能」与 `/customizations` 页面新增按需「翻译说明」胶囊，点击即翻、再点还原，不主动产生额外网络请求。
- **更精简的按需语言包体验**：将繁体中文（`zh-TW`）与粤语（`yue`）、日语（`ja`）统一改为按需云端下载（插件基础包仅内置简体中文与英文，进一步瘦身）；修复词库同步与重置的 JSON 请求体，并在设置页清晰区分「云端」与「云端已更新」状态及绿色一键更新按钮。

### 5. 暖白 Windows 安装器、测试版通道、旧文件自清理与可靠性加固

- **暖白安装包与更新日志自动汉化**：Windows 一键安装器升级为 Claude 暖白视觉风格并持久化桌面/开始菜单快捷方式图标；随包附带的 `scripts/fetch-agy-changelog.mjs` 新增 Antigravity 官方更新日志自动中文翻译（同时退役重复的 `check-agy-update.mjs`）。
- **测试版通道与控制室精修**：设置页新增可选的「接受测试版本推送（`receivePrerelease`）」开关、更紧凑的单开手风琴设置分组与去灰框词库列表；「对话」页支持活跃任务置顶与恢复；配置升级至 `configSchemaVersion: 2`，旧版配置升级后自动启用常驻 Studio 侧栏。
- **`src/` 架构整理与旧文件自清理**：核心运行代码统一收拢至 `src/` 并移除 11 个旧版平铺脚本；新增基于 SHA-256 白名单的 `v2.2.4` 前根目录遗留文件自动清理（保留任何用户自定义修改），在线升级后自动通过干净子进程触发热重注。
- **CLI 隔离、安全与 Windows 代理透传**：隔离 `antigravity-cli` 宿主与桌面端 CDP 注入及数据目录写入，避免 CLI 启动干扰桌面端运行态；加固侧栏子进程环境变量隔离、旧文件清理边界与发布 CI 6 处版本号硬门禁；Windows 端重启 Antigravity 时安全透传进程级代理环境变量（`HTTP_PROXY`、`HTTPS_PROXY`、`ALL_PROXY`、`NO_PROXY`、`NODE_USE_ENV_PROXY`）并自动清理临时脚本（PR #4，感谢 `@fexpopopoi`！）。

### 升级、迁移与平台说明

- **已安装原生插件的用户**：直接在 Antigravity 右侧 **Claude Studio** 面板顶栏点击「升级」即可原地无损更新（本次升级会自动清理 `v2.2.4` 之前遗留在插件根目录的旧版文件，同时完整保留 `PLUGIN_DATA/` 内的个人配置、推送凭据与自定义脚本，并按 `configSchemaVersion: 2` 启用常驻侧栏）。
- **Windows 一键安装器（推荐）**：下载 `Claude-Studio-v2.3.0-Windows-x64.exe` 双击运行，全新暖白界面自动部署并启用原生插件、清理旧版遗留进程与文件，并创建持久化的桌面与开始菜单启动入口。
- **macOS / Linux 与跨平台通用插件包**：下载 `Claude-Studio-v2.3.0-plugin.zip` 解压至 `~/.gemini/config/plugins/`（形成 `~/.gemini/config/plugins/agy-claude-studio`），重启开启本地调试端口的 Antigravity 并在插件列表中启用即可。维护者目前没有 Mac 真机环境，macOS/Linux 暂不提供独立打包安装器，请使用通用插件包或让 Antigravity 里的 Gemini 按 README 协助安装。

---

## What's New in v2.3.0

`v2.3.0` brings major multi-pane workspace and visual upgrades: an **independent persistent 3-column Claude Studio Dock**, **titlebar pinning for any UI sidecar plugin**, **5 explicit light and dark palettes**, Claude-style Environment menus with a complete `/btw` side-question workflow, full Antigravity `v2.36.0` localization, an on-demand Skills translation pill, a warm-ivory Windows installer refresh, and broad reliability hardening including CLI host isolation, safe legacy file cleanup, and Windows proxy preservation.

### 1. Independent Persistent Claude Studio Dock & Titlebar Plugin Pinning

- **Persistent 3-Column Studio Dock**: Pin Claude Studio to the far right as an independent third column (`pinRightPane: 'studio' | 'off'`) so it stays visible alongside the browser, file viewer, terminal, or other Aux Pane tabs — complete with solo dock mode, an SVG dock badge, aux sidebar bounce safeguards, and titlebar width compensation.
- **Zero-Frame Full-Screen Yield & Titlebar `✦` Collapse**: Automatically hides the pinned dock and its iframe with zero-frame delay whenever the Aux Pane is maximized (such as full-screen image viewing) and restores cleanly afterward. Collapsing the pinned dock shrinks it to `0px` and surfaces a single terracotta `✦` button to the left of `⋮` in the conversation titlebar.
- **Pin Any Sidecar Plugin to the Titlebar**: Every row in the `⋮ → Plugins` submenu now includes a `📌` pill to pin or unpin any UI sidecar plugin without opening it or closing the menu. Pinned plugins render with their original icons to the left of `⋮`, support 3-state click toggling (open / switch / close-collapse), deduplicate automatically against the collapsed Studio `✦` button, can be toggled anytime under **Settings → Advanced → Titlebar Plugin Pinning** (`toolbarPluginPin`), and include fixes for multi-conversation bridge accuracy and Aux Pane tab close detection.

### 2. 5 Explicit Light & Dark Palettes

- **Five Symmetric Choices**: Upgraded the palette picker to `Claude (Light)` (`claude`), `Claude (Dark)` (`claude-dark`), `Obsidian (Light)` (`obsidian`), `Obsidian (Dark)` (`obsidian-dark`), and `Host Native` (`host`), clearly labeled across all 5 languages.
- **Consistent Rendering Across Host Themes**: Explicit light and dark palettes apply cleanly regardless of Antigravity's own light or dark theme, covering CSS tokens, code syntax highlighting, chart palettes, effort sliders, glassmorphism overlays, and the Studio sidecar panel; also upgrades the Gemini-chan loading animation to a 12-tick halo ring.

### 3. Claude-Style Environment Menus, /btw Side-Question Workflow & Composer Polish

- **Claude-Style Environment Menus**: Adds a quick branch and Git worktree selector menu with `.repo + worktree/` container repository detection and a dark branch hover tooltip.
- **End-to-End `/btw` Side-Question Tracking**: Tracks `/btw` side questions right inside the Studio Chat tab with unified calm empty/active card styling, strict multi-session isolation, and concise `Side` (`旁` / `副`) activity badges.
- **Continue Compact Preset & Seamless Slash Token Swaps**: Adds a `continue` ("Continue") preset for `/compact`. Switching between `/compact` and `/btw` replaces existing Lexical slash tokens cleanly in place while preserving normal user drafts and active IME composition.
- **Grouped Model Pill & Native Control Isolation**: Combines `✦` and the model name into a unified hover/open pill (suppressing the overlapping native model menu) with a separate equal-height effort pill. Adds `effortSliderStyle: 'off'` to keep Antigravity's native effort control (collapsing the Periodic Table entry to `✦` only), and cleanly isolates native composer layout and glass styling when `composerRestyle: false`.

### 4. Antigravity v2.36.0 Localization, Skills Translate Pill & On-Demand Locale Packs

- **Full Antigravity v2.36.0 String Sweep**: Covers new Side Question, New Tab, and Settings strings across all 4 locale packs (`zh-CN`, `zh-TW`, `yue`, `ja`) and dynamic rules, plus stale cloud pack protection so older remote packs never overwrite newer built-in entries.
- **On-Demand Skills Translate Pill**: Adds a "Translate Descriptions" pill in Settings → Skills and `/customizations` that translates on click and toggles back to original text with zero background requests.
- **Leaner Bundle & Clearer Sync Status**: Moves Traditional Chinese (`zh-TW`) to on-demand download alongside Cantonese (`yue`) and Japanese (`ja`) so the base bundle ships only `zh-CN` and `en`. Fixes JSON request bodies
